items.title: Ecoppia T4 datasheet
items.scope: Single-axis tracker geometry; up to 400 m² nightly, 3 m²/min; own PV dock; vendor maintenance. Product claims, not an independent reliability or cost estimate.

items.title: SolarCleano F1
items.scope: Portable remote-controlled wet/dry cleaning with one operator, setup and access limitations. Its stated daily MW coverage is not an autonomous service rate.

items.title: ExRobotics products and services
items.scope: Inspection payloads, commissioned routes, charging, connectivity and service provision. Endurance and unattended-period claims lack an exposed fleet denominator.

items.title: AutoInspect: Towards Long-Term Autonomous Industrial Inspection
items.scope: Two deployments report mission success and minor/serious/fatal interventions. Calendar deployment time differs from active operation and intervention-free duration.

items.title: ANYmal X
items.scope: Advertised Zone 1 IIB and inspection capabilities. This does not establish IIC hydrogen-area eligibility for the proposed payload and configuration.

items.title: Taurob Operator
items.scope: Explicitly a prototype. Constrained manipulation is a design prospect, not evidence of autonomous hydrogen-system replacement.

items.title: A Robot Factors Approach to Designing Modular Hardware
items.scope: Prepared mechanical/electrical and water-filter interfaces; redesign enables constrained manipulation. Laboratory tasks are not qualified hydrogen repairs.

items.title: DJI Dock 3 specifications
items.scope: Dock max input 800 W and 12 m/s landing/operation wind specification. Backup power excludes aircraft charging and some thermal loads; maximum draw is not standby demand.

items.title: EASA Specific Category — Civil Drones
items.publication: Current page accessed on review date
items.scope: BVLOS operation is an example within the specific category; site and mission authorization remain separate from dock automation. EU scope.

items.title: UK CAA categories of UAS operations
items.publication: Current page accessed on review date
items.scope: UK operation has its own applicable authorization framework; European product availability is not permission for a London mission.

items.title: Reinforcement Learning for RUG
items.scope: Specialist contact/ultrasonic inspection. Requires accessible material and a corresponding integrity model; no generic repair capability.

items.title: Renu Robotics autonomous vegetation management
items.scope: Renubot, recharge infrastructure and Mission Control remote monitoring form a service system. Does not remove all human maintenance.

items.title: Swagelok calibration and switching modules
items.scope: Conditioned sample/reference routing with pneumatic actuation. Not a complete analyzer or a hydrogen-flow calibration procedure.

items.title: Endress+Hauser Liquiline Control CDC90
items.scope: Automatic pH/ORP cleaning/calibration with compatible assemblies and utilities, non-Ex applications. Not a hydrogen flow meter remedy.

items.title: Emerson corrosion and erosion monitoring
items.scope: Technology-specific ultrasonic, acoustic and intrusive observations. A sensor family does not confer general fault observability or remaining-life truth.

items.title: Rotork IQ3 Pro intelligent actuators
items.scope: Purpose-built actuation and feedback. Cause-specific reset/interlock semantics require an engineered equipment interface; this product is not evidence for the simulated electrolyser reset.

items.title: Maximo completes 100 MW of robotic solar installation
items.evidence_type: Company press release hosted by Nasdaq
items.scope: Company-reported installation deployment. Construction task scope and site crews remain; not independent O&M autonomy evidence.

items.title: Next-generation Terafab completes field testing
items.scope: Version-specific field-test/deployment announcement; planned availability is not a completed fleet deployment.

items.title: 5B Maverick
items.scope: Pre-wired deployable PV blocks use people and a telehandler. A site design alternative, not autonomous daily maintenance.

items.title: DOE technical targets for PEM electrolysis
items.scope: System 55 kWh/kg is a status guidepost; target 51 kWh/kg is aspirational. Continuous-life values do not determine intermittent-duty fault rates.

items.title: Hydrogen Shot Water Electrolysis Technology Assessment
items.scope: Stack and balance-of-plant scope, dynamic durability and development needs. No equipment-specific repair hazard or duration for this fixture.

items.title: Enapter EL 4.1 handbook
items.scope: AEM equipment illustrates cause-specific faults, reset conditions, service escalation, utilities, telemetry and venting. Structural analogy only; do not transfer AEM numerical values to an unspecified 450 kW plant.

items.title: Bronkhorst MV-191-H2 datasheet
items.scope: Range-dependent reading/full-scale accuracy and temperature effects differ from 2% independent Gaussian noise. Flow/pressure scope is not a proposed plant meter selection.

items.title: DNV hydrogen and renewable flow calibration
items.scope: Hydrogen-specific reference facilities and operating ranges. Blend calibration uncertainties cannot be transferred to pure-H2 or arbitrary on-site calibration.

items.title: Ignition and flow stopping considerations for hydrogen networks
items.scope: Hydrogen gas-group IIC distinction; paper network/pressure scope differs from this plant. Used only to flag equipment certification compatibility.

items.title: Soiling losses — impact on photovoltaic power plants
items.evidence_type: IEA PVPS technical report executive summary
items.scope: Site-dependent soiling and measurement uncertainty. Global loss estimates are not London, Seville or Copenhagen daily deposition rates.

items.title: EU harmonised protocols for testing low temperature water electrolysers
items.access: PDF contents and relevant testing sections inspected
items.scope: Reference conditions and measurement requirements; dynamic loading, cold starts and standby transitions require specified tests. Not field failure-rate data.

items.title: Determination of reaction kinetics in three phase CO₂ methanation
items.scope: Reaction enthalpy and heat-management rationale supported; the liquid/catalyst experiment does not calibrate the fixture thermal capacity, heat loss or operating band.
